facts: The former Circus Carré opened in 1887. Its plastered eclectic neo-Renaissance facade and curved roof are principal protected features.
The 2004 works raised the auditorium ceiling and included a new foyer within the bowed roof.

The surveyed ground is 0.263 m NAP and the highest modeled roof element is 32.829 m NAP. The low front roof and rear flat sections are distinct from the higher auditorium roof. © 3DBAG by tudelft3d and 3DGI. Height and size measurements only.
